release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.30 adds the new nested Tasks sidebar hierarchy. Pokémon Center, Target, Walmart, Amazon, Login Cookies, and ATC Cookies are the six parent entries. Named groups remain hidden beneath their parent until expanded, and selecting a group opens only that group's task workspace. The new group flow creates groups directly under the selected parent. This release also includes the stability fixes validated by Chromium E2E, the 120-task soak, Windows consumer E2E, Linux preflight, Member Build Boundary, Architecture Guard, Prebuild, and CodeQL.
